messages:
ana: Heads-up — I'm targeting a release cut for v2.7.0 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Can we get a quick branch-readiness + CI green sweep? Please call out any outstanding changelog or version-bump PRs.

mike: On it. Kicking a full CI run across release/* and main now. Will post failures. 

ci-bot: [CI] started pipeline: build+tests for refs/heads/release/v2.7 @ 1954321020

hannah: I have a doc tweak PR for the changelog (PR #482). It's minor but should land before cutoff. @ana want it squashed into the changelog commit or separate?

ana: squash is fine. we want the changelog to be deterministic. mike, if your sweep is clean i'll merge and bump.

mike: First run had 3 flakes in integration tests (search-index flaky on mac). Re-ran the failed jobs (rerun-command: ci rerun 1954321020 --only integration). 

qa-alan: I can triage the search-index flake. Seen it before — usually env race due to local index warmup. Will add a retry + explicit wait in the test if it reproduces.

ryan: FYI, I pinned a dep in platform-telemetry to avoid a build timeout (PR #489). That was causing spurious docker layer failures in infra-image build.

mike: Second run looks better: 2 jobs failed (flaky/k8s-scaling), both seem unrelated (timeouts), requeued.

ci-bot: [CI] pipeline success: all required checks green on release/v2.7 @ 1954321285

sophia: Nice. Who's doing the version bump and release notes? I can draft the release notes from changelog.md once bumped.

ana: I'll do the version bump + tag once we confirm the changelog includes #482 and #489. Please make sure changelog.md has the 'Unreleased' section moved into v2.7 heading.

hannah: Done — pushed changelog update and squashed with #482. Please check.

mike: Verified changelog presence. CI green on the changelog commit too.

ana: ok i'm going to bump to 2.7.0, tag, and start the publish job in ~5m. If anyone wants rollback window, call it now.

sophia: +1, will monitor post-publish metrics and alert if error rate spikes.

qa-alan: I'll keep an eye on end-to-end smoke tests post-release.

ana: publish started: ./scripts/release/publish --tag v2.7.0

ci-bot: [RELEASE] deploy job queued for v2.7.0 @ 1954321389

mike: thanks all. If any last-minute flakes show up in next 10m we can still hold the cut.

hannah: all good from docs side. :tada:

ana: release complete — tag v2.7.0 pushed, changelog updated, release notes draft in PR #495. Closing thread, file any post-release issues in #incidents.

ci-bot: [RELEASE] succeeded: v2.7.0 published @ 1954321398
